description: Computing Necessary Conditions for Near-Optimality in Capacity Expansion Planning Problems - Code is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Antoine Dubois, Radu David (University of Liège). This repository contains the version of REplan that was used to generate results of the paper 'Computing Necessary Conditions for Near-Optimality in Capacity Expansion Planning Problems', Dubois A., Ernst D, PSCC2022. It is also accessible on the REplan Github repository. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
